casesDropdown.title: CRM & ERP Integration
casesDropdown.challenge: Develop a solution that integrates the current Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system with a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system for the architecture and interior design sector. The challenge was to synchronize the management of B2B and B2C accounts with projects at a single point, improving operational efficiency, resource allocation accuracy, and providing a unified view of project conceptualization, design, and execution.
features: Unified management of clients and projects between CRM and ERP.
Integrated dashboard for real-time tracking of project progress, providing client visibility and internal time reporting.
Automation of invoicing and accounts receivable tracking within the project workflow.
Coordination of purchases and budgets through the integrated ERP platform.
Profitability analysis of projects and portfolio management of services.
casesDropdown.solution: The integration of HubSpot (CRM) with Asana (project management) and Holded (ERP) provides a complete solution for managing architecture and interior design projects. The solution allowed users to have a comprehensive view of the customer and project lifecycle, from customer acquisition to final project delivery and after-sales service.
tools: HubSpot: for advanced customer relationship management and automated marketing.
Asana: for detailed project planning and task tracking.
Holded: for efficient management of financial and accounting operations, purchases, and inventory management.
Custom API integrations to synchronize data between systems.
Customized dashboards for reporting and performance analysis.
Enterprise-level data security and GDPR compliance.

casesDropdown.title: Budget Configurator
casesDropdown.challenge: Develop a system for creating and calculating customized budgets for construction and logistics projects that integrates efficiently with the existing ERP. The goal was to streamline budget creation, allowing for different configurations and increasing data processing speed to improve decision-making, client justifications, and financial planning.
features: Creation of dynamic budgets based on project variables such as materials, labor, machinery, and logistics.
Customizable templates for different types of construction and logistics services.
Integration of supplier catalogs and real-time pricing.
Analysis tools to compare budgets and historical costs.
Scenario simulation to evaluate the impact of different variables on the final budget.
casesDropdown.solution: The integration of the budget configurator based on a WebApp and integrated with Odoo provides a flexible and powerful platform for the financial management of construction and logistics projects. By connecting with the existing ERP, this solution allows for the creation, validation, and external export of budgets to communicate project finances to Odoo.
tools: Odoo: for detailed budget management and configuration, leveraging its flexibility and customizable modules.
AWS: for cloud computing infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
Business Intelligence modules for data visualization and decision-making based on advanced analytics.
APIs for integrating data from external suppliers and real-time price updates.
Compliance with international security standards and data notice policies.

casesDropdown.title: End2End Tool Integration for eCommerce
casesDropdown.challenge: Create and develop an API Orchestrator that integrates ERP, CMS, different marketplaces, and Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers for the Dropshipping and Logistics industry. The goal is to improve operational efficiency and customer experience by simplifying the management of purchases, sales, and logistics.
features: Single interface to manage operations across different eCommerce platforms and marketplaces.
ERP integration for efficient resource and inventory management.
Connection with 3PLs to optimize the shipping and delivery process.
Advanced analytical tools through Google Looker for data-driven decision-making.
Real-time synchronization of orders and stock between marketplaces and the management system.
casesDropdown.solution: Implementing a unified API Orchestrator that connects Odoo (ERP), Prestashop (CMS), Huboo (3PL), and Amazon Selling Central provides a comprehensive view of the eCommerce process. This solution facilitates automation and synchronization between platforms, ensuring smooth and transparent end-to-end management.
tools: Odoo as the ERP system for centralized business administration.
Prestashop for content management and online store management.
Huboo as the logistics and shipping management system.
Amazon Selling Central for integration with the Amazon marketplace.
Google Looker for data analysis and advanced reporting.

casesDropdown.title: Integrated Platform for Creative Agencies
casesDropdown.challenge: Implement a solution that integrates project management tools, CRM, and task management for creative agencies. The aim is to improve campaign planning, creative resource management, and client communication.
features: Centralized management of projects and clients.
CRM integration for tracking clients and business opportunities.
Task management and collaboration tools for creative teams.
Real-time visualization of project progress and resource allocation.
Performance analysis of campaigns and projects.
casesDropdown.solution: The integration of tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud (content creation), Trello (task management), Slack (communication and collaboration), and Salesforce (CRM) provides a robust platform for campaign and project management. This solution allows for better planning, tracking, and analysis of creative activities, ensuring smooth communication with clients.
tools: Adobe Creative Cloud: For creating and editing creative content, including graphic design, video, and other digital media.
Trello: For task and project management, allowing for visual organization and tracking of task progress.
Slack: For real-time communication and collaboration among team members, facilitating coordination and idea exchange.
Salesforce: For customer relationship management, tracking of business opportunities, and marketing automation.
Zapier: For the integration and automation of workflows between different tools, ensuring efficient data synchronization.
Google Analytics: For data analysis and evaluation of campaign and creative project performance.

faqsDropdown.question: What is a custom digital product?
faqsDropdown.answer: A digital product meets the needs of users, business objectives, and market opportunities to provide the best solution to the customer. It differs from standard solutions in that it adapts to the specific processes and tools of the client, offering greater flexibility and efficiency.

faqsDropdown.question: How do you ensure you understand what I need?
faqsDropdown.answer: Our process begins with discovery and analysis meetings where we delve into use cases to ensure we understand all the needs before starting development.

faqsDropdown.question: Why choose a custom software solution instead of a standard one?
faqsDropdown.answer: Standard solutions are often generic for any type of business, usually include unnecessary functions that complicate their use, and are not easily "integrated" with other solutions that may already be integrated. A custom solution is designed to integrate perfectly with your way of working, improving productivity and efficiency.

faqsDropdown.question: Will I have support and maintenance when development is finished?
faqsDropdown.answer: Of course! If you want us to take care of maintenance and support, we will do so as we have a dedicated team for it where we will be delighted to solve any problems that may arise.

faqsDropdown.question: Who will develop my solution?
faqsDropdown.answer: At Gigson Solutions, we have different collaborators specialized in each part of the process to provide a complete service adapted to the needs of the client such as software development, usability, marketing, and graphic, legal, etc.

faqsDropdown.question: Will I own my solution?
faqsDropdown.answer: If you want, you can be the sole owner of the product we develop to gain a competitive advantage.

faqsDropdown.question: What is the difference between Gigson Solutions and hiring a developer?
faqsDropdown.answer: The main difference is that a developer will implement what you think, define, and prioritize. It is rare for them to ask aspects like whether it is really what the business needs, the pricing model, or the security of the information.

faqsDropdown.question: How is security and privacy handled in new products?
faqsDropdown.answer: Security and privacy are a priority in all our solutions. We adopt secure coding practices and can certify the products we develop following standards like GDPR, SOC2, or HIPAA.

faqsDropdown.question: Can I coordinate the product development myself?
faqsDropdown.answer: Yes, however, we do not recommend it as a lack of experience in managing technical teams can lead to communication misunderstandings, poor risk management, and resource management.

faqsDropdown.question: Have we left anything unanswered?
faqsDropdown.answer: We'll be happy to address any other questions you may have. You can reach out to us at info@gigsonsolutions.com or through our contact form.

dialog.solutionDescription: Desarrollamos un sistema de fichaje basado en WhatsApp que se conecta directamente al software de nóminas de Martínez Marcos. Esto permitió automatizar el registro de horas, eliminando errores manuales y garantizando el cumplimiento normativo. Además, la solución es accesible y fácil de usar para los empleados, lo que aumentó la tasa de cumplimiento de fichajes en un 100%.

answer.challengeDescription: Esteba Maderas trabaja con proveedores variados que envían sus tarifas y catálogos en formatos diferentes, como PDF o Excel. La actualización manual de precios y la introducción de nuevos productos en el ERP genera errores, consume tiempo y retrasa la generación de presupuestos precisos
answer.solutionDescription: Implementamos un sistema que automatiza la extracción de datos de tarifas y catálogos, conectándolo directamente al ERP de Esteba Maderas. Esto permitió reducir los tiempos de actualización en un 70% y garantizar que las tarifas y productos estén siempre actualizados en la herramienta de generación de presupuestos. Además, los errores en los precios ofrecidos a los clientes disminuyeron en un 40%.

functionalities.description: Parseo automatizado de documentos: Herramienta que extrae información de tarifas y catálogos en PDF o Excel para convertirlos en datos estructurados.

Validación previa de datos: Interfaz que permite revisar y aprobar los datos parseados antes de la actualización final.
Sincronización con la herramienta de presupuestos: Conexión entre los precios actualizados y la herramienta de generación de presupuestos dinámicos, asegurando precisión en las ofertas al cliente.
Notificaciones automáticas: Alertas sobre cambios importantes en tarifas o condiciones para mantener a los equipos informados.

answer.challengeDescription: Con una flota en crecimiento, nuestro cliente buscaba reducir su huella de carbono para cumplir con objetivos internos de sostenibilidad, mejorar su imagen frente a clientes B2B y reguladores, y proporcionar transparencia en sus operaciones. Sin herramientas para calcular emisiones, optimizar rutas y ofrecer reportes detallados a los clientes, las operaciones del transporte eran ineficiencientes y sin visibilidad.

answer.challengeDescription: La gestión de órdenes de trabajo en distintas etapas (carga, transporte, descarga) generaba descoordinación entre departamentos, provocando errores operativos, retrasos y pérdida de visibilidad global sobre el avance de las operaciones. Cada equipo trabajaba con sistemas o documentos diferentes, dificultando la trazabilidad y la toma de decisiones en tiempo real.
answer.solutionDescription: Se diseñó una solución modular basada en una plataforma de flujo de trabajo colaborativo que conecta todos los departamentos implicados en la operativa diaria. A través de la implementación de un sistema de gestión de órdenes tipo "Kanban dinámico", cada orden de trabajo avanza entre estados (pendiente, en carga, en tránsito, entregado) con visibilidad en tiempo real para almacén, transporte y atención al cliente. Además, se incorporó una capa de trazabilidad por orden que registra automáticamente cambios de estado, tiempos de ejecución y responsables de cada tarea.

solutionsApplications.title: Transformación y digitalización de la construcción
solutionsApplications.subTitle: Trabajamos con constructoras porque no solo entendemos las herramientas, también entendemos los problemas propios de un sector con muchas particularidades, personal muy cualificado, con una gran barrera tecnológica, donde cuesta cambiar, y donde se dedica demasiado tiempo a procesos repetitivos que no aportan valor. Aportamos nuestra experiencia como consultora tecnológica para ayudarte a integrar soluciones digitales que se adapten a tu forma de trabajar, no al revés.

containers.title: Desarrollo e integración de software para constructoras
containers.description: La tecnología sólo funciona si se adapta a los procesos reales de tu empresa. Diseñamos e integramos software teniendo en cuenta cómo se gestiona una obra en la práctica: con equipos diversos, cambios constantes, plazos ajustados y herramientas que muchas veces no se comunican entre sí. Nuestro objetivo es ayudarte a conectar y optimizar tus sistemas para que todo fluya.

cards.title: Integración de ERP, BIM y herramientas de gestión de obra
cards.description: Unificamos tus sistemas para que puedas planificar, ejecutar y controlar desde un único entorno conectado. Integramos herramientas como ERP, BIM y software de planificación para que la información fluya sin duplicidades ni errores.

cards.title: Desarrollo de software a medida para planificación, ejecución y control
cards.description: Creamos soluciones a medida cuando los productos estándar no se ajustan a tus necesidades. Desde aplicaciones internas hasta herramientas de control de avance o dashboards de obra, desarrollamos tecnología con foco en el uso real y el retorno operativo.

cards.title: Conexión entre herramientas como Presto, Revit, MS Project o Navisworks
cards.description: Hacemos que tus herramientas actuales trabajen juntas. Automatizamos el intercambio de datos entre Presto, Revit, MS Project y otras plataformas para evitar tareas manuales, errores de versión y pérdida de información.

cards.title: Soluciones personalizadas para digitalizar procesos o coordinar proyectos
cards.description: Analizamos tus flujos y diseñamos soluciones específicas para mejorar la coordinación entre equipos, la trazabilidad de decisiones o la supervisión de proyectos desde la oficina, la obra o el móvil

containers.title: Control de costes, planificación eficiente y gestión de obras
containers.description: En construcción, el margen está en los detalles: saber con precisión cuánto cuesta cada fase, si se están cumpliendo los plazos y qué impacto tiene cada cambio. La tecnología puede darte ese control, pero solo si está bien implementada y adaptada a tu forma de trabajar. Te ayudamos a conectar la planificación con la realidad de la obra y a tomar decisiones con información fiable y actualizada.

cards.title: Control de costes, planificación digital y gestión de plazos
cards.description: Implantamos sistemas que te permiten controlar el presupuesto en tiempo real y conectar la planificación con la ejecución. Ya no se trata solo de tener un cronograma: se trata de saber cómo afecta cada desviación a tus márgenes y poder anticiparse.

cards.title: Automatización de seguimiento de cambios en proyecto y obra
cards.description: Cuando cambias un material o ajustas una partida, todo el proyecto se ve impactado. Automatizamos el seguimiento de esos cambios para que su impacto quede registrado, evaluado y comunicado a tiempo. Sin correos sueltos ni decisiones que se pierden.

cards.title: Trazabilidad de decisiones, materiales y presupuestos
cards.description: Diseñamos sistemas que permiten rastrear cada decisión, justificar cada partida y vincular proveedores con sus costes e impacto en obra. Pero no solo se trata de registrar: el valor está en generar reporting claro y accionable, que permita tomar decisiones basadas en datos reales y actualizados. Así se evitan sobrecostes, malentendidos y retrasos, y se gana en control y transparencia durante todo el proyecto.

containers.title: Transformación digital y automatización de procesos
containers.description: Digitalizar no es solo cuestión de software, sino de estrategia. Automatizamos tareas repetitivas, digitalizamos documentación clave y te ayudamos a introducir tecnologías cuando tienen un impacto real en la obra o en la gestión.

containers.title: Soporte y gestión del cambio
containers.description: No solo entregamos tecnología: te acompañamos durante todo el proceso de adopción para que el cambio sea real y sostenible. Formamos a tu equipo en el uso práctico de las soluciones, adaptadas a su día a día. Nos involucramos en la gestión del cambio, ayudando a que los procesos se integren con naturalidad y los equipos los hagan suyos.  Y una vez implantadas las herramientas, seguimos ahí: ofreciendo soporte continuo, resolviendo dudas y ajustando lo que haga falta para que la transformación digital no se quede a medio camino.

CTO.title: CTO as a Service | Gigson Solutions
CTO.metadescription: Upgrade your tech strategy, lead digital transformation, and reduce operational risks with an external CTO.

hero.title: CTO as a Service: custom tech strategy
hero.description: In a world where technology directly impacts efficiency and competitiveness, many SMEs face a common challenge: they need strategic and operational tech leadership, but can’t afford the financial and structural burden of hiring a full-time CTO. And even if technology isn’t their core, they need it to operate, grow, and make better decisions. That’s where the CTO as a Service model makes total sense. At Gigson Solutions, we act as a technology partner—not just consultants. We help you define and execute a tech strategy that fits your business structure, without imposing generic tools or methodologies. We support startups, scaleups and established companies with one clear focus: making technology a driver, not a blocker.

solutionsApplications.title: Tech leadership and advisory for frictionless growing companies.
solutionsApplications.subTitle: Not all companies need a full-time CTO, but all need high-level tech direction. Our Fractional CTO service integrates a tech leader into your team to detect opportunities, avoid mistakes, and align technology with your business goals. From day one, we deliver realistic, actionable tech advice—with direct impact on operations and growth.

containers.title: Cost optimization & operational efficiency
containers.description: Reducing costs without losing responsiveness is possible when technology is planned with business vision. An external CTO can help identify inefficiencies in your current setup and suggest sustainable solutions—not just quick fixes.

cards.title: Cost analysis, optimization, reorganization and scalability
cards.description: We perform a full audit of your tech ecosystem—from licenses to HR and processes. Where’s the money going? What can be automated? What tools are we paying for but not leveraging? We then design a transformation plan focused on scaling efficiently and sustainably.

cards.title: Measuring tech investment ROI
cards.description: This isn’t about tech for tech’s sake. We evaluate each decision using clear metrics: How much value does it bring? What’s the impact on revenue, costs, productivity? Will it still serve us in X years? We work with data, not guesswork or trends.

cards.title: Agile solutions and bottleneck identification
cards.description: A slow or poorly organized tech stack slows growth and increases errors.We analyze key flows and help your team unblock the critical friction points that prevent agility and scalability.

containers.title: Global vision & business impact
containers.description: Having technical insight without business context is as inefficient as making business decisions without understanding tech implications. The value of a CTO as a Service lies in bridging these worlds and anticipating the impact of each step.

cards.title: Strategic vision and tech diagnosis
cards.description: We start with a full audit: What tech is in place?What are your business goals?What gaps exist? This lets us build a roadmap where tech and strategy are integrated cohesively.

cards.title: C-level support in key decisions: translating tech into business terms
cards.description: We actively participate in your executive team, owning the tech vision at decision level. We translate technical language into strategic options, propose actionable paths and evaluate every decision by its risks, costs, and potential impact.Tech shouldn’t be an afterthought—it belongs at the table where the future is decided.

cards.title: Cross-functional coordination with tech providers & decision makers
cards.description: Tech doesn’t live in isolation. We coordinate across internal and external teams—aligning providers, developers and executives—to ensure everyone is focused on one thing: achieving business goals.

containers.title: Tech strategy, planning & innovation
containers.description: A company’s tech strategy can’t be reactive. It needs to anticipate change, integrate innovation, and ensure every decision adds real value.With our CTO as a Service, your company doesn’t just survive—it evolves.

cards.description: A weak architecture limits growth.We design or audit your systems to ensure they support your present and scale for the future—incorporating best practices in modularity, security, and efficiency.

cards.title: Security best practices
